chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: Louis Barbarin's daughter, Louis Nelson and the Biblical genealogy
summary: They joke that the family tree reads like Matthew, with Barbarin, Santiago, Marrero, Williams and Frazier families all intertwined.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I see here that Louis Barbarin's daughter married Louis Nelson. Is that King Oliver's...
No, that's not the same one.
Louis Nelson is a trombone player here, and he had a brother who played saxophone. I don't know his brother's name. I can't think of it now. I knew it years ago.
Now, Louis Barbarin's daughter, that's Paul Barbarin's...
It sounds like the first chapter from The New Testament, don't it.
[LAUGHS] Yeah... Most of them, like (?) and Isidore... Isidore begat Paul and Paul begat...and so on and so on... There's one of them books in the Bible that's... Genesis...
That's the genealogy of Jesus Christ, I think it is, Matthew. It starts that way, telling everybody...
Like the first part of the Bible.
Well, that's how it is here. Well, the Santiago family is involved the same way. The Marrero family is involved the same way. The Marrero's, the Williams and the Fraziers.
